big_case.notes: Formed from the record and the outcome: a private commercial dispute over a nursing home between Orthodox Jewish litigants, raising a real church-autonomy and compelled-speech question (a state injunction barring beis din proceedings and ordering the seruv withdrawn), with Becket as amicus and Notre Dame's clinic on the application. But the event itself was an in-chambers denial by a single Justice, without referral, without prejudice, on exhaustion grounds: no full-Court engagement, no separate writing, no government party, no policy at stake. The question could return after state remedies are exhausted, which keeps this above the floor. Note: the predictors' big_case_score values sit inside the staged prediction.json and were visible before this read was formed; see evaluation.md.
